exposure: Mean echogenicity of the puborectalis muscle (MEP)
Mean echogenicity of the vastus lateralis muscle
outcome: Echogenicity of the vastus lateralis muscle
cohort: 306 nulliparous women with a singleton pregnancy
finding: The study found no significant association between levator hiatal dimensions, MEP on pelvic floor muscle contraction, echogenicity of the cervix, or echogenicity of the vastus lateralis and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: The study investigated the association between various pelvic floor measurements and mode of delivery, but no significant association was found.
